sources.note: Index manifest names, descriptions, versions and entry counts only. Keep MCP server configs, tool schemas, endpoints and credentials in their owning source; hydrate selected manifest/schema only after permission review.

sources.locator: Explicit --extra-root paths only (for example $HOME/workspace/project); home-directory scans require explicit allowlisting.
sources.note: Symlinks are skipped; roots are allowlisted per invocation; candidate records use external:<root>/<relative-path> identity and remain unverified until provenance review.

Existing Termux/ArchWiz taxonomy baseline. all_tools.jsonl contains 3,388 valid JSONL tool records, 243 package/source groups and 104 tags; TOOL_TAXONOMY.json reports 25 roles. README claims 3,387 tools and embeds unrendered shell substitutions. categories/ and roles/ are derived views; modules/ are the generator; python3/ and delta/ are generated projections; state/ is a 531-entry device/package-state snapshot excluded from default content hydration. REPO_INFO declares NO_REMOTE. Treat tool availability as unverified until a current device scan confirms it; do not execute build_tool_taxonomy.sh in CI because it invokes Termux package and local-environment scanners.

Issue lists SHA256SUMS.txt, plugins-inventory.csv, skills-inventory.csv and skills-SKILL-md-all.tar.gz. The supplied SHA256SUMS content lists five skills-part-00..04.tgzpart files, not the combined archive or CSV/JSONL files; the issue body supplies no skills-inventory.jsonl or split-part attachments. Do not infer checksum verification from the generated source-manifest archive hash.

PR #5667 contains scripts/skills/import_claude_export.py, scripts/skills/validate_claude_export.py, vendor/skills-mirror, .skills/index.json and source-manifest records for 1,299 skills and 1,218 plugin inventory rows. The importer requires skills-inventory.jsonl although Issue #5657 does not list it; it copies SHA256SUMS.txt but does not parse or verify it. Archive SHA-256 is computed after extraction and is not compared with the supplied sums. Keep imported content unverified until the source artifacts and checksum chain reconcile.
